title: SETTINGS CHIPS JUMP RIGHT ON A BIG SCREEN
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the section chips at the top of Settings (THE RAID, AUDIO, CONTROLS, CONTROLLER, DISPLAY, ACCESSIBILITY) measured how far to scroll in zoomed pixels and scrolled the list by that many unzoomed pixels. On a 4K screen, where the menu is zoomed about 2x, every chip overshot and the list came back on THE RAID; at 1440p each chip fell short; only 1080p was right. Proven in headless Chromium with the Settings window at zoom 2: {"AUDIO":"THE RAID off=1515","CONTROLS":"THE RAID off=2557","CONTROLLER":"THE RAID off=3843","DISPLAY":"THE RAID off=4834"}; with the fix every chip lands at off=0 with its own chip lit. The distance is now divided by the menu zoom.
now: The Settings section chips jump to their section on a 1440p or 4K screen too.
